kept.q: In genetics, the actual genetic make-up of an organism, which controls its characteristics but may not always be seen outwardly, is called the
kept.explanation: Genotype is the set of genes an organism carries for a trait, while phenotype is the physical expression of those genes. Genotype can be hidden if the gene is recessive.
kept.pidgin: Genotype na di gene wey dey inside body wey dey control character, e fit no show for outside. Phenotype na wetin we see for outside.

kept.q: Which of the following human traits is an example of discontinuous variation?
kept.explanation: Blood group falls into distinct classes (A, B, AB, O) with no in-between forms, so it is discontinuous. Height, weight and skin colour show a range of values, making them continuous.
kept.pidgin: Blood group get clear categories like A, B, AB, O, no mixture dey between dem, so na discontinuous. Height, weight and skin colour dey change small small, so na continuous.

kept.q: In maize, tallness (T) is dominant over shortness (t). A heterozygous tall maize plant (Tt) is crossed with a short plant (tt). What is the expected ratio of tall to short offspring?
kept.explanation: Tt x tt gives gametes T,t from one parent and t,t from the other, producing Tt and tt offspring in equal numbers. This gives a 1:1 ratio of tall to short plants.
kept.pidgin: Tt x tt go give Tt and tt offspring for equal number. So di ratio of tall to short na 1:1.

kept.q: A man with normal colour vision marries a woman who is a carrier for colour blindness (heterozygous, X^N X^n). What proportion of their sons is expected to be colour blind?
kept.explanation: Sons get their X chromosome from the mother only. Since she is X^N X^n, half her eggs carry X^n, so half of the sons (X^n Y) will be colour blind.
kept.pidgin: Boy pikin dey collect im X chromosome from mama only. Since mama na X^N X^n, half of her eggs get X^n, so half of di boys go be colour blind.

kept.q: In guinea pigs, black coat (B) is dominant over white (b), and short hair (H) is dominant over long hair (h). A guinea pig heterozygous for both traits (BbHh) is crossed with a white, long-haired guinea pig (bbhh). What fraction of the offspring is expected to be black and short-haired?
kept.explanation: This is a test cross (BbHh x bbhh), which gives four phenotypes in equal 1:1:1:1 ratio. So black, short-haired offspring make up 1/4 of the total.
kept.pidgin: Na test cross be dis (BbHh x bbhh), e go give four phenotypes for equal 1:1:1:1 ratio. So black, short hair go be 1/4 of di total pikin dem.

kept.q: A man with blood group AB marries a woman with blood group O. Considering that blood group O is genotype ii while AB has both I^A and I^B alleles, what blood groups can their children have?
kept.explanation: The AB parent gives either I^A or I^B gametes, while the O parent gives only i gametes. Combining these gives genotypes I^A i (blood group A) or I^B i (blood group B), so the children can only be group A or B.
kept.pidgin: Papa wey be AB go give I^A or I^B, mama wey be O go give only i. If you combine dem, you go get I^A i (A) or I^B i (B), so di pikin dem fit be only A or B.
